integrity: The infinite classification follows from explicit necessity/sufficiency case analysis and binomial identities. Exhaustive m<=3 computations support the proof but are not a substitute for it. The logical confluence axioms originate in cited published work.
scientific_limitations: Only two confluence conditions over labelled m-leaf one-top fans are classified; no extra F-conditions, valuations, arbitrary trees or full models counted; independent scientific validation not performed. An older multivalued-map classification may imply the result.
title: Exact confluence spectra on finite coalescing fans
